{
  "Select": ["assay_chembl_id", "target_type", "tax_id", "canonical_smiles", "molecule_chembl_id", "standard_type", "pchembl_value"],
  "Source": ["activities", "assays", "target_dictionary", "compound_structures", "molecule_dictionary"],
  "Join": ["activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id", "activities.toid = target_dictionary.tid", "activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno", "activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno"],
  "Filter": ["activities.standard_relation = '='", "activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL", "activities.standard_type = 'IC50'", "target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293274'"],
  "Sort": ["molecule_chembl_id ASC", "assay_chembl_id ASC"],
  "Limit": 1000
}
